notes: Timing fixtures can skip clocks and grant invulnerability to isolate rules; they are not natural difficulty evidence.
Real fixture tests/fixtures/g1_900s_two_midbosses.json was generated by unchanged sibling G1 arena_sim.gd under the G1 project path; its provenance sidecar records source and fixture hashes.

G1 migration preserves every existing entity and awarded stat. Carried concurrent bosses stay concurrent; tracked ownership transfers immediately on death, and recovery/future boss spawns wait until all carried bosses die. Both kill orders and immediate G2 resaves are checked.
Replay comparison permits 1e-8 absolute numeric round-off from Godot JSON parsing; RNG state strings and collection order remain exact.
G2 intentionally defers newly scheduled boss deadlines until prior boss defeat and recovery. Base weapon/enemy damage arrays are unchanged.
